channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: FBI: Second ransom deadline for Nancy Guthrie expires today
item.description: The apparent ransom note in the Nancy Guthrie abduction demanded $6 million in bitcoin by 5 p.m. today (3 p.m. Hawaii time) in exchange for her return, sources told the Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell refuses to answer questions in House deposition
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Ghislaine Maxwell, the longtime companion of Jeffrey Epstein who is serving a federal prison sentence on sex-trafficking charges, refused today to answer questions during a deposition before the House Oversight Committee.

item.title: Yen strengthens after Japanese election, dollar weakens
item.description: NEW YORK/LONDON >> The yen strengthened today after Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s election victory, reversing six consecutive days of losses, and the dollar fell against other major currencies following a report that Chinese regulators have advised financial institutions to curb their exposure to U.S. Treasury bonds.

item.title: Oahu residents asked to conserve water during severe weather
item.description: The Honolulu Board of Water Supply this morning is once again asking all Oahu customers to conserve water due to current and potential power outages related to severe weather conditions islandwide.

item.title: Dow sets second straight record as tech rebound fuels Wall Street gains
item.description: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq rose solidly after a shaky start today, as technology stocks found their footing following last week’s AI-sparked selloff, while investors waited for key economic data that could shed light on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.

item.title: Chloe Kim defends athlete speech after Trump calls skier ‘real loser’
item.description: MILAN/LIVIGNO >> American athletes have the right to speak their minds, double Olympic snowboarding champion Chloe Kim said on Monday, stepping into a row that has spilled from the Italian Alps into U.S. politics.

item.title: AI in the operating room: Reports of botched surgeries, misidentified body parts rise
item.description: In 2021, a unit of healthcare giant Johnson & Johnson announced “a leap forward”: It had added artificial intelligence to a medical device used to treat chronic sinusitis, an inflammation of the sinuses. Acclarent said the software for its TruDi Navigation System would now use a machine-learning algorithm to assist ear, nose and throat specialists in surgeries.

item.title: U.S. reaches nuclear deal with Armenia
item.description: TBILISI >> Armenia and the United States agreed on Monday to cooperate in the civil nuclear sector as Washington sought to bolster ties with a former close ally of Russia, months after Washington brokered a peace agreement in the South Caucasus.

item.title: Shark warning signs posted at Nanakuli Beach Park
item.description: Shark warning signs have been posted at Nanakuli Beach Park after a sighting of a pair of sharks this afternoon.

item.title: Lahaina man, 59, dies from injuries day after highway crash
item.description: Maui police say a man died a day after a two-vehicle collision on Honoapiilani Highway over the weekend.
